review.algorithm_assessment: Keyboard distance equals sum of edge weights crossing each prefix cut. Subset DP chooses the last letter and adds cut(mask). Compute cut by removing the lowest bit and updating its incident weights. Handles absent letters and repeats; O(m2^m) time with compact integer arrays rather than permutation enumeration.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.

{"function": "write_file", "params": {"path": "solution.py", "content": "import sys
from array import array
v=sys.stdin.buffer.read().split();n,m=int(v[0]),int(v[1]);s=v[2];weights=[[0]*m for _ in range(m)]
for a,b in zip(s,s[1:]):
 a-=97;b-=97
 if a!=b:weights[a][b]+=1;weights[b][a]+=1
N=1<<m;cut=array('i',[0])*N;dp=array('q',[0])*N;degree=list(map(sum,weights));index={1<<i:i for i in range(m)}
for mask in range(1,N):
 bit=mask&-mask;i=index[bit];rest=mask^bit;inside=0;t=rest
 while t:b=t&-t;inside+=weights[i][index[b]];t^=b
 cut[mask]=cut[rest]+degree[i]-2*inside
 best=10**18;t=mask
 while t:b=t&-t;best=min(best,dp[mask^b]);t^=b
 dp[mask]=best+cut[mask]
print(dp[-1])
"}}
